净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Simplified mutation of parent vol_asym_001: replace EWMA std with rolling std to reduce noise and improve predictive signal. The core leverage effect hypothesis is preserved: negative returns increase subsequent volatility more than positive returns.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

downside_vol = ts_std(20, neg_returns); upside_vol = ts_std(20, pos_returns); factor = downside_vol - upside_vol
依赖列: close

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

downside_vol = ts_std(20, neg_returns); upside_vol = ts_std(20, pos_returns); factor = downside_vol - upside_vol
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(ts_std(neg_returns, 20), ts_std(pos_returns, 20))
  2. 2. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(neg_returns, 20)
  3. 3. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(pos_returns, 20)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  2. 计算 pos_ret：ret.clip(lower=0)
  3. 计算 neg_ret：ret.clip(upper=0)
  4. 计算 upside_vol：pos_ret.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).std()
  5. 计算 downside_vol：neg_ret.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).std()
  6. 计算 factor：downside_vol - upside_vol

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_downside_volatility_persistence(df): """Asymmetric volatility persistence: difference between downside ">class="kw">and upside rolling volatility.""" df_copy = df.copy() ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change() pos_ret = ret.clip(lower=0) neg_ret = ret.clip(upper=0) upside_vol = pos_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std() downside_vol = neg_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std() factor = downside_vol - upside_vol df_copy["factor_downside_volatility_persistence"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_downside_volatility_persistence"]
